name: Animal Vision MR
summary:
**See the World Through Animal Eyes in Mixed Reality!**

Animal Vision MR is an entertainment experience that applies animal-themed vision filters to your surroundings using the Meta Quest 3/3S color passthrough. Discover a new way to look at your own home with these unique visual effects.


**🚀 Early Access & Free to Play**

This app is in active development. We welcome your feedback to make it better!


**Disclaimer:** This app is for entertainment purposes only. The visual effects are artistic interpret
